description: The arm set that docs/validation-baselines.md section 3 describes in prose.
It lives here, in tracked source, because until 2026-09-05 the only
executable copy of it was an untracked shell script under ~/projects that
no clone had and no cleanup spared. `ptm_validate_baseline.py run` reads
this file, `bank` copies each recipe into the manifest, and
`verify --rerun` replays the recipe out of the manifest -- so a bank is
reproducible from itself, not from a script somebody has to still have.

crater80N_coupled.vf.note: H-matrix, built once and then LOADED by the arm, so the arm is inert to a view-factor change (that is what the two vfbuild arms are for).

crater80N_hmat.vf.note: HMAT v2. The format carries no physics provenance stamp, so a stale cache loads silently -- check the md5 the manifest records, never the version.

crater80N_sparse.vf.note: VFFM v2 sparse. v1 files from the 2026-07 zero-occlusion window contain no occlusion at all; v2 announces itself on load.

moon_crater80N_coupled_cpu.covers: CPU thermal, H-matrix view factors, CPU two-band radiosity, the coupling loop

moon_crater80N_radoff_cpu.covers: Illumination plus CPU thermal with radiation disabled

asteroid_bennu_spice_cpu.covers: Generic-body thermophysics on a real SPICE ephemeris and an imported facet shape

asteroid_keplerian_cpu.covers: Generic-body thermophysics on the analytic Keplerian propagator

europa_diurnal_cpu.covers: Europa built-in body, primary-body infrared and reflected light, a full eclipse inside the output window

moon_crater80N_vfbuild_sparse.covers: The SPARSE view-factor builder, matrix BUILT not loaded

moon_crater80N_vfbuild_hmatrix.covers: The H-MATRIX builder including its ACA low-rank compression, matrix BUILT not loaded

moon_crater80N_gputhermal_n1.covers: GPU persistent-kernel thermal solver, single device, two-phase cadence

moon_crater80N_gputhermal_n2.covers: The multi-GPU THERMAL pool at 2 devices

moon_crater80N_gputhermal_n4.covers: The multi-GPU THERMAL pool at 4 devices

moon_crater80N_radgpu_n2.covers: The multi-GPU RADIOSITY pool at 2 devices

moon_crater80N_radgpu_n4.covers: The multi-GPU RADIOSITY pool at 4 devices

moon_crater80N_radgpu_gray_n4.covers: Gray radiosity on the pool. N=1 versus N>1 MAY legitimately differ here: the single-GPU path clears warm_start only in two-band mode while the pool clears it unconditionally.
